eval.description: Google DeepMind's umbrella name for three agentic capture-the-flag tiers used to rule out cyber Autonomy Level 1: easy (InterCode-CTF), medium (GDM in-house / Internal CTF suite), and hard (a fixed Hack the Box selection). The agent must break into a simulated target and retrieve a hidden flag. A challenge is solved if any of N attempts succeed. InterCode-CTF, Internal CTF suite, and Hack the Box have their own registry entries.
eval.summary: Tests whether AI agents can break into simulated targets and find hidden flags without human help.

versions.changes: Three-tier suite as described in Phuong et al. and Gemini 2.5 cards (InterCode-CTF easy; in-house CTF medium; Hack the Box hard).

scores.description: The agent captures the flag on at least one of N attempts for that challenge.

metrics.description: Share of challenges solved. Cards report counts by difficulty (easy / medium / hard).
